measurements.compression_note: Members are STORED (method 0) rather than deflated, which is why the zip size and the extracted total are nearly identical.

station_id_form.note: Short-name form as expected, confirming the GBFS short_name join key rather than the UUID station_id.

isolation.defect_found_and_corrected: landing_subdir joined with '/', which first placed the archive at landing/historical_trips/202401-full - inside the sample's own landing root. Auto Loader discovers recursively, so a later sample-mode run would have found 1.9 million monthly rows as new files and failed its 40-row expectations. The namespace is now a sibling, the nested directory was removed, and a regression test pins the invariant.

not_done.note: No expected post-ingestion counts are recorded here. 1,888,085 is the measured CSV row count, not a prediction about valid/quarantine/duplicate splits, which the run itself must determine.
